title: Lucky Thirteen Voodoo Berry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lucky Thirteen’s Voodoo Berry is a spellbinding berry flavour e-liquid that layers deliciously sweet and tangy dark berries for a sharp and enervating fruity vape with an irresistibly smooth finish. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50P blend fuses fantastic flavour and cloud production, while the high nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for newer ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
